title: Kubra bani hai dulhan  Qasim bana hai dulha
body:
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir bante hai ibne hassan ko sehra...
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hota hai aaqd e qasim Binte shahe zaman se
Lipti hai bekasi bhi Noushaha ke badan se
Wada jo bhai se tha karte hai shaha pura....
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sharbath dur bibi pani nhi mayasar
Ankhao se dekhlo tum mazlumiyath ka manzer
Beti se keh rehe hai sar ko jhuke moula...
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dulha dulhan hai pyase pyase hai sub barathi
Chahi hui hai ghar me khushiyon ki jaa udaasi
Beta ki le rahi hai barkar balaye farwa...
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Qasim zaroor hoga barpa ek or mehshar
Dekhe gi kis tarha se beva dulhan wo manzer
Aayega samne jab pamaal hoke lashaa..
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Qasim tere badan ke tukre aaba me lana
Sheh se liye hai mushkil lasha tera utha na
Dar hai ghame hassan bhi phir hona jaye taza..
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Binte hassain ye gham phir kis tarha se sayegi
Jab bazuao me uske kal reesma banegi
Dulhan jo ab bani hai ban jayegi wo bewa..
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khushiyon ke phool dashte ghurbath me kya khilegay
Ab jo juda hue toh meshar ke din milegay
Kuch sathaao ka hai bus dulha dulhan ka rishta...
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kubra se hora hai ruqsat hassan ka dilbar
Rote shah e wala hai bibiyon me meshar
Baraath ki tarha se niklega ab janaza...
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aale nabi ke ghar ki kaise bayaan ho shaadi
Askhao ka silsila hai chasme khalam se jari
Sadiq yeh sochta hai sehra kahe k nouha...
<<MINI>>
Kubra bani hai dulhan
Qasim bana hai dulha
